extraction_caveats:
1. The schedule is published as individual mileage columns (5,000 / 7,500 / 10,000 / 15,000 … 120,000 mi) rather than a simple repeating-interval table. Repeat intervals have been inferred by observing the pattern of columns where each item appears; the manual does not explicitly state 'every X miles' for most items other than CVT fluid and engine coolant.
2. Engine coolant first replacement is explicitly stated as 105,000 miles/84 months; subsequent interval is 75,000 miles/60 months per footnote on page 496.
3. CVT fluid replacement is explicitly stated as mileage-only (no time interval). Standard schedule replacement columns are 30,000 / 60,000 / 90,000 / 120,000 mi. Severe schedule replacement columns are 30,000 / 60,000 / 90,000 mi.
4. Air cleaner filter standard replacement appears at 30,000 / 60,000 / 90,000 mi columns; no time interval is stated for this item in the schedule columns.
5. Intelligent Key battery standard replacement appears at 45,000 / 67,500 / 90,000 / 112,500 mi columns; first at 45,000, then every 22,500 mi. No time interval stated.
6. Brake fluid severe-use replacement interval is inferred from the pattern of severe-use columns (10,000 / 20,000 / 40,000 / 50,000 / 70,000 / 80,000 / 100,000 / 110,000 mi); the manual does not state a single repeat interval explicitly for severe brake fluid.
7. Engine valve clearance has no fixed mileage interval; the manual states 'inspect only if valve noise increases.'
8. Fuel filter: 'Periodic maintenance is not required (in-tank type filter)' — not included as a maintenance item.
9. The manual covers up to 120,000 miles/144 months and instructs to continue at the same intervals thereafter.
10. Steering gear & linkage, axle & suspension parts, and exhaust system appear on standard schedule at 30,000-mile intervals (30k/60k/90k/120k), not every 7,500 miles. They appear every 5,000 miles on severe schedule. These have been split into separate standard and severe entries.
11. Drive shaft boots appear on standard schedule at every 15,000-mile interval (15k/30k/45k/60k/75k/90k/105k/120k).
12. Engine drive belts first inspected at 60,000 mi standard, then every 15,000 mi (60k/75k/90k/105k/120k).
